note: MECHANISM CANDIDATE ONLY. Simple two-player simultaneous inspection game; not a claim about observed interstate holiday attacks. Interior mixed strategy valid only if 0 < c0 + d*h < L, h is 0 or 1, and v, ell > 0. Requires original-paper scrutiny, full domain proof and credible data.
title: Holiday readiness costs and attack timing: a two-by-two inspection-game candidate
information: The upcoming holiday h in {0,1} and parameters c0,d,L,v,ell are common knowledge. Defender readiness and attack decisions are simultaneous/private; neither observes the other's current action.
timing: Nature announces h. Attacker chooses Attack or Wait, Defender chooses Ready or Rest simultaneously. If attacked while resting, Defender suffers loss L; readiness prevents damage but costs c0+d*h; an attack against readiness incurs attacker loss ell.

payoffs.Attacker: Attack yields -ell when Defender is Ready, v when Defender Rests; waiting yields 0.
payoffs.Defender: Ready always costs c0+d*h and prevents damage; Rest incurs loss L only if attacked, otherwise 0.

solution_concept: Interior mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium conditional on strict admissibility 0<c0+d*h<L, v>0 and ell>0; uniqueness and corner cases require independent checking.
equilibrium_argument: Attacker indifference requires defender readiness mixing q=v/(v+ell). Defender indifference requires attacker attack mixing p=(c0+d*h)/L. These are algebraic necessary conditions, and with both mixing probabilities in (0,1) imply mutual best responses. Full equilibrium coverage and appropriateness for interstate warfare are not independently established.

comparative_statics.hypothesis_text: When holidays raise defenders' readiness costs while other incentives remain fixed, attack attempts become more likely.
comparative_statics.interpretation: Under the stated interior mixed equilibrium, dp/dh=d/L>0, conditional on d>0, L>c0+d and invariant opponent incentives. This does NOT imply all holidays increase interstate war.
